query: SELECT v.source_id, v.transit_period, g.phot_g_mean_mag, g.grvs_mag, g.radial_velocity, g.radial_velocity_error, g.rv_nb_transits, g.rv_amplitude_robust, g.rv_chisq_pvalue, g.rv_renormalised_gof, g.rv_template_teff FROM gaiadr3.vari_planetary_transit AS v JOIN gaiadr3.gaia_source AS g ON g.source_id = v.source_id ORDER BY v.source_id
